metadata.case_name: IP WAN FUNG v. CHEUNG WING HONG T/A BILLION RESTAURANT CO

plaintiff.occupation_before: food product salesman (employed by Tsit Wing Coffee Company Limited)

source: he hit his head against the glass door of the Restaurant and then fell to the ground and landed on his back. He sustained personal injuries at the back and the head (“the Accident”).
There was local tenderness over his low back. The clinical diagnosis was back contusion.
There was tenderness from L2 downwards.
There was decrease in back range of movement for extension and mild muscle waste at right calf.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

manifestations.description: local tenderness over his low back
persistent back pain which exacerbated on walking and prolonged standing
back pain over his lateral aspect of left leg
lumbar rotation was 3/4 on the right side and 2/3 on the left side
Straight Leg Raising (SLR) range was 70° on the right and 60° on the left side with pain
myotone of the L2 and S1 was grade 4, myotone of L3 to L4 was grade 4+ and myotone of L5 and S2 was grade 5-
intermittent and daily attacks of low back pain that last for 2-3 minutes
pain after walking for 15 minutes while holding samples of food products or bending down to lift heavy objects
decrease in back range of movement for extension
mild muscle waste at right calf

treatments_received.treatment: admitted overnight for observation at Queen Elizabeth Hospital
source: After the Accident, Mr. Ip was sent to Queen Elizabeth Hospital (“QEH”) for medical treatment. There was local tenderness over his low back. The clinical diagnosis was back contusion. He was admitted overnight for observation and was discharged on 31 March 2009.

treatments_received.treatment: attended Department of Family Medicine & General Outpatient Clinic at Fanling (4 times)
source: Between 3 April 2009 and 17 April 2009, Mr. Ip had attended the Department of Family Medicine & General Outpatient Clinic at Fanling (“the GPOC”) for 4 times. He complained of persistent back pain which exacerbated on walking and prolonged standing.

treatments_received.treatment: physiotherapy (initial assessment 7 August 2009; last session 16 September 2009; total 5 sessions then defaulted)
source: Mr. Ip was referred to the Physiotherapy Department, North District Hospital, for treatment. In the initial assessment on 7 August 2009, Mr. Ip complained of back pain over his lateral aspect of left leg. The lumbar rotation was 3/4 on the right side and 2/3 on the left side. The Straight Leg Raising (SLR) range was 70° on the right and 60° on the left side with pain. The myotone of the L2 and S1 was grade 4, myotone of L3 to L4 was grade 4+ and myotone of L5 and S2 was grade 5-. His last session was on 16 September 2009. He defaulted treatment after 5 sessions as from 24 September 2009 due to work.

treatments_received.treatment: consultations with orthopaedic and traumatology specialists in private practice (Dr. Poon Kai Ming, Dr. Chang Shao, Dr. Yong Kong Fan and Dr. Hung Siu Lun) on various occasions between April 2009 and August 2009
source: Mr. Ip had consulted Dr. Poon Kai Ming, Dr. Chang Shao, Dr. Yong Kong Fan and Dr. Hung Siu Lun, who are specialists in orthopaedics and traumatology in private practice, on divers occasions between April 2009 and August 2009 respectively.

treatments_received.treatment: out-patient treatments at government clinics from time to time after the Accident
source: Mr. Ip sought and is still seeking out-patient treatments at government clinics from time to time after the Accident.

treatments_received.treatment: examination by single joint medical expert Dr. Wong See Hoi on 17 March 2011
source: Mr. Ip was examined by Dr. Wong See Hoi (“Dr. Wong”), the single joint medical expert, on 17 March 2011. He complained there were intermittent and daily attacks of low back pain that last for 2-3 minutes. There was pain after walking for 15 minutes while holding samples of food products or bending down to lift heavy objects.

treatments_future.treatment: physiotherapy scheduled to receive in September 2012
source: He was scheduled to receive physiotherapy treatment in September 2012.

losses.description: Disadvantage in the labour market; less competitive position as a food products salesman because part of the duties is to carry product samples for business promotion and Mr. Ip is clearly in a less competitive position when compared with those who are able-bodied.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Chung Keung v Greenroll Limited trading as Conrad Hong Kong
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff slipped and fell on the wet floor and landed on his bottom. There was no fracture. The court found that this was no more than a soft tissue injury which exacerbated a pre-existing weakness caused by the natural ageing process.

comparable_cases.case_name: Cheng Liu Nei Su v Clare Environmental Services Limited
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff fell off from a ladder and landed on her buttocks and back. The plaintiff sustained some soft tissue injury but there was no major structural damage to the back.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tam Kwok Man v The Kowloon Motor Bus Company (1993) Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: the plaintiff fell on the ground from an office chair sustaining back injury resulting in minor back impairment and residual pain.
